headline: World Bank Targets 17 Million Jobs Through Childcare Investments in Nigeria
summary: The World Bank Group advocated for increased public and private capital investment in Nigeria's childcare sector, estimating that expanded quality services could generate 17 million new jobs.
why: The World Bank funds infrastructure and socio-economic projects aimed at reducing poverty in emerging markets.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: World Bank targeted 17 million job additions from childcare investment in Nigeria.
